MIND. [1] [Caps.]
Homesickness : with red cheeks and sleeplessness ; with hot feeling in fauces.
After emotions, fever, with red cheeks.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Caps.]
Headache, as if skull would split, when moving head, walking, or coughing.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Caps.]
Painful swelling behind ear ; periostitis and caries of mastoid process.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Caps.]
Taste : sour ; flat, watery, followed by heartburn ; foul, like putrid water. θ Diarrhœa. θ Intermittent. θ Dysentery.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Caps.]
Burning blisters in mouth. θ Scarlatina.
Tough mucus in mouth, or dryness.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Caps.]
Tough congealed mucus in posterior nares, on rising in morning, requiring much hawking to dislodge.
Tonsillitis with burning, smarting pain.
Great soreness in throat, with smarting. θ Scarlatina.
Burning and other pains in throat < between acts of deglutition.
Throat inflamed, dark red, burning, pressing.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Caps.]
Dipsomania ; morning vomiting, sinking at stomach.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Caps.]
Stomach icy cold, or burning in it.
Dyspepsia from torpidity, particularly in old people.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Caps.]
Burning or cutting pains in abdomen. θ Hemorrhoids.
Peculiar feeling in abdomen, a sort of drawing ; he must bend double.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Caps.]
Dysentery : tenesmus and strangury ; pain < from a current of air, even if warm.
After stool :tenesmus ; burning at anus ; thirst, drinking causes shuddering ; drawing pains in back.
Smarting and burning pain in anus and rectum. θ Diarrhœa. θ Dysentery.
Violent tenesmus. θ Dysentery.
Tenesmus of rectum and bladder at same time.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Caps.]
Burning in bladder. θ Dysentery. θ Gonorrhœa.
Tenesmus vesicæ ; strangury. θ Dysentery.
Burning, smarting after urination.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Caps.]
Gonorrhœa : second stage ; white discharge, like cream ; excessive sensibility of parts to contact ; chordee, which can only be appeased or subdued in cold water.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Caps.]
Disordered menstruation, with a pushing or sticking sensation in left ovarian region.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Caps.]
Hoarseness from straining voice, in singers, preachers, etc.
   

COUGH. [27] [Caps.]
Nervous, spasmodic cough.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Caps.]
Coldness beginning in back. θ Intermittent.
   

NERVES. [36] [Caps.]
Lack of reactive force, especially with fat people.
   

FEVER. [40] [Caps.]
Shivering and chilliness after every drink.
Hectic fever after emotions, and in nostalgia.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Caps.]
As if Cayenne pepper was sprinkled on parts.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Caps.]
Relaxed fibre : obesity.
Intermittent fever.
   

SKIN. [46] [Caps.]
Burning in skin.
